da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict: minor-to-major-revision (honest but mislabelled). referee_argument: The mathematics is correct and standard, and the block is commendably honest that it axiomatises (md 'Mathematical Novelty' + explicit QCasimir.exists_axiom). The strongest objection is structural integrity: a block of kind 'proposition' whose Lean ref resolves to an axiom-projecting inhabitation theorem that captures neither the centrality nor the eigenvalue it states. The genuine structural work (centrality QCasimir_comm_K, eigenvalue QCasimirEigenvalue, EF/FE equivalence) lives, partly sorry-free and partly axiomatised (QCasimir_comm_E_axiom, q-casimir.lean:614), in the sibling def file — but the existence proposition itself points at the weak inhabitation lemma. Recommend either retargeting the lean.ref to the centrality/eigenvalue theorems or restating the proposition to match Nonempty (QCasimirData), and surfacing that E/F-centrality remains an axiom.
